component.name: Peppermint
component.summary: Fast native local music player with tabbed playlists and 10-band EQ

description.p: Peppermint is a fast, native COSMIC desktop local music player built with Rust and libcosmic. Designed around a spacious frosted translucent stage and effortless playlist control, it brings the tactile playlist-first feel of classic players to a modern Wayland desktop.

ul.li: Multi-tab resizable playlists: switch tabs without interrupting playback, rename inline, hover-scroll long track titles, and import/export M3U8 files.
Full drag-and-drop ordering: drag tracks to reorder or drop audio files and folders straight from COSMIC Files.
Built-in Track Info and Tag Editor: inspect audio file details and edit embedded tags, album art, and lyrics directly in your music files.
Stylish Lyrics Viewer: bold synced LRC and plain-text lyrics in a separate frosted pop-out window or inside the main stage visualizer rotation.
Slide-out 10-band graphic equalizer: real-time pure-Rust biquad DSP with preamp, bypass, presets, and a live response curve.
Semi-transparent background visualizers: Aurora Orbit, Kaleidoscope, and Cosmic Nebula floating behind free-floating album art.
Collapsible local library browser supporting MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, M4A, AAC, and AIFF.

screenshot.caption: Frosted translucent player stage with Aurora visualizer and multi-tab drag-and-drop playlist

description.p: Major feature and polish update for Peppermint on the COSMIC desktop.

ul.li: Resizable playlist sidebar (up to 50% of window width) with uniform single-line track cards and hover-scrolling titles.
Separate frosted Track Info and Tag Editor window to view file details and edit embedded tags, album art, and lyrics.
Bold synced and plain-text Lyrics Viewer available both as a pop-out window (under the EQ tab) and inside the main visualizer rotation.
Free-floating album art with drop shadow, fixed Wayland/Flatpak file drag-and-drop, and 100% native COSMIC symbolic icons.

description.p: Initial release of Peppermint for the COSMIC desktop.

ul.li: Spacious frosted translucent stage with centered album art and large bottom media controls.
Multi-tab drag-and-drop playlists with COSMIC Files drop support and M3U8 import/export.
Top-left slide-out 10-band graphic equalizer with 10 presets and live frequency curve.
Three semi-transparent FFT background visualizers (Aurora, Kaleidoscope, Nebula).
